findings.detail: TC-1 wording nit: 'no ring-* utility remains' could make a naive grep match border-ring. Suggest 'no ring-* WIDTH/COLOR utility remains (ring-2, ring-ring/50 gone); border-ring is a border-* utility and stays'.

The claim that border-ring is 'overridden by focusedStyle.borderColor at render' is asserted rather than probed (probe-b tested border-ring alone, not competing with a same-property style prop). Consequence is cosmetic-only and the required focused-composer screenshot asserts the 50% alpha, so it is caught. Suggest softening to 'expected to be overridden'.

summary: Corrected diagnosis independently verified from the raw probe artifacts on branch FIX-ORI-RN-003-2-impl (2ce0997): probe-c (focused && 'ring-2') is the sole failure (navigation_context_error_present true, maestro_exit 1); probe-a/b/d/e all pass with completed Maestro focus/type/send flows. Probes a-d are byte-identical except the single conditional term. The corrected fix is charter-legal (remove ring-2/ring-ring/50; hoisted focusedStyle borderWidth:2 + comma-form hsla borderColor at 0.5; dark:bg-input/30 stays as a proven-clean class), the visual consequence is stated honestly as an accepted approximation, GREEN covers nativewind iOS AND Android light+dark plus uniwind/web, and DOC-1..DOC-7 are preserved. Source is still unfixed (line 35 retains ring-2), so the premise holds.
